status: immutable record - reruns must write a new file, never overwrite this
question: Which indicators can be removed from production without losing information?
instruction: Operator asked for a reduction on 2026-09-08 and delegated the choice.

supersedes.its_recommendation: Keep production's 27 indicators. No change is supported.
supersedes.why_overridden: That study asked whether a candidate set was BETTER than production and production_reduced came back INCONCLUSIVE (Wilcoxon p=0.0173 against a 0.0167 Bonferroni threshold). The question here is different: does removing provably redundant columns HURT? On the same measurement it does not - production_reduced was better on MAE, direction and rank IC simultaneously, with the paired strategy CI entirely positive. Removal is adopted on absence of harm plus provable redundancy, not on a claim of improvement.

removed.evidence: 10Y - 2Y - spread = 0 on all 565 stored sessions, max error 0. Holding all three makes the design matrix rank deficient; the derived column carries zero information. Needs no measurement.
cash close stops 05:00 JST; sp500_futures trades to the 08:30 cutoff
30 large caps against two US index futures already held
no path from gold to Japanese equity open-to-close returns
same China large-cap exposure as FXI, to within tracking error
dropping the ADR columns moved 14 of 1,386 predictions and was slightly better on all three metrics

prior_measurement.caveat: That mirror did not contain us_2y_yield or us_10y_minus_2y_spread, so the rank-deficiency fix adopted here was never measured. It is an arithmetic identity and does not need to be.

why_now: Ridge selected the maximum alpha in 1,078 of 1,078 predictions and logistic the minimum C: cross-validation is asking for more shrinkage than the grid allows.

Live measurement on 2026-09-08 over 18 sessions and 708 predictions: regression of actual on predicted gives b=+0.072 (t=0.98), R^2=0.0014, and mean absolute error 1.337pt against 1.248pt for predicting zero. The model is currently worse than doing nothing, which is not a state in which to add predictors.
known_limits: No new measurement was run for this change. It rests on the 2026-08-16 study for nine of the ten removals and on an arithmetic identity for the tenth.
The 2026-08-16 mirror used SPY rather than the configured ^GSPC, and lacked six series with no free history.
63 sessions. The paired trading test was underpowered at that length and still is.
This does not claim the reduction improves anything. It claims no measured harm, provable redundancy, and a smaller feature budget.
how_to_reverse: Set enabled: true on the ten indicators in config/indicators.yaml and restore them to common/sectors. Their verified sources were left intact for exactly this reason.
next_check: Re-run docs/research/2026-08-16 style comparison once 20+ settled sessions exist under the reduced set, and re-measure b and rank IC on live data.
